2026-11-05GACSpecial Economic Measures ActRegulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations in order to (1) add twenty-four (24) individuals and thirty-eight (38) entities to the Schedule 1 of the Regulations and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs; (2) extend an exception for financial services required to obtain legal services for listed vessels in relation to the application of the prohibitions set out in the Russia Regulation; and (3) make non-substantive corrections to the various Schedules.Registration: SOR/2026-0233 Publication Date: 2026-11-18
subject: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations in order to (1) add twenty-four (24) individuals and thirty-eight (38) entities to the Schedule 1 of the Regulations and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs; (2) extend an exception for financial services required to obtain legal services for listed vessels in relation to the application of the prohibitions set out in the Russia Regulation; and (3) make non-substantive corrections to the various Schedules.
